thesis: This episode argues that Netflix is undervalued and necessary despite potential price hikes, while also highlighting the attractive economics and growth of a Coca-Cola bottler in Turkey. Additionally, it emphasizes a bullish outlook on the connected TV space due to structural changes in advertising revenue relative to streaming viewership.
